CreateJob.title: Create a job
CreateJob.summary: Creates a job to run in a cluster. You can specify the datasource config, code source configuration, startup command, and compute resource configuration for each node of the job.

CreateSignal.title: Create signal
CreateSignal.summary: Sends a signal to the Pods of a specified job and retrieves the signal ID.

CreateTensorboard.title: CreateTensorboard
CreateTensorboard.summary: Creates a TensorBoard by using a job or specifying a data source configuration.

DeleteJob.title: DeleteJob
DeleteJob.summary: Deletes a completed or stopped job.

DeleteJobTemplate.title: DeleteJobTemplate
DeleteJobTemplate.summary: Deletes a job template. You cannot delete a job template that is in use by a job.

GetDashboard.title: GetDashboard
GetDashboard.summary: Retrieves the Dashboard URL for a DLC job, if available.

GetJob.title: Get node details
GetJob.summary: Retrieves the detailed configuration and runtime information of a node.

GetJobEvents.title: GetJobEvents
GetJobEvents.summary: Obtains the system events of a job.

GetJobMetrics.title: GetJobMetrics
GetJobMetrics.summary: Obtains the monitoring data of a job, including the CPU, GPU, and memory utilization, network, and disk read/write rate. ⚠️ Note: Except for pay-as-you-go tasks based on general-purpose computing resources, all task types are connected to CloudMonitor. Use the CloudMonitor API to call related monitoring. The overwritten features in the original API are no longer maintained. For more information, see \\[Training monitoring and alerting]\\(https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/pai/user-guide/training-monitoring-and-alerting).

GetJobSanityCheckResult.title: GetJobSanityCheckResult
GetJobSanityCheckResult.summary: Obtains specified job sanity check result in a Deep Learning Containers (DLC) job.

GetJobTemplate.title: GetJobTemplate
GetJobTemplate.summary: Retrieves the details of a job template.

GetPodEvents.title: GetPodEvents
GetPodEvents.summary: Obtains the system events of a specific node in a job to locate and troubleshoot issues.

GetPodLogs.title: GetPodLogs
GetPodLogs.summary: Obtains or downloads the logs of a node for a task. The logs are from the stdout and stderr of the system and user scripts.

GetRayHistoryServer.title: GetRayHistoryServer
GetRayHistoryServer.summary: Retrieves the details of a specific RayHistoryServer.

GetSignal.title: Get signal details
GetSignal.summary: Queries the details of a specific signal in a specified job.

GetTensorboard.title: Get tensorboard details
GetTensorboard.summary: Retrieves the details of a Tensorboard instance.

GetTensorboardSharedUrl.title: GetTensorboardSharedUrl
GetTensorboardSharedUrl.summary: Obtains the shareable link of a TensorBoard task. The link contains digital tokens. You can use a shareable link to access a TensorBoard task.

GetToken.title: Retrieve a task sharing token
GetToken.summary: Retrieves a sharing token for a DLC job, which is used to view information about the shared task.

GetWebTerminal.title: GetWebTerminal
GetWebTerminal.summary: Provides methods and steps to obtain a HTTP link for accessing a container.

ListEcsSpecs.title: ListEcsSpecs
ListEcsSpecs.summary: Queries the list of supported instance types.

ListJobSanityCheckResults.title: ListJobSanityCheckResults
ListJobSanityCheckResults.summary: Obtains the results of all sanity checks for a DLC job.

ListJobTemplates.title: ListJobTemplates
ListJobTemplates.summary: Lists job templates in a specified workspace. You can paginate, sort, and filter the results by creator, `TemplateId`, or `TemplateName`.

ListJobs.title: Get job list
ListJobs.summary: Retrieves a list of jobs with support for pagination, sorting, and conditional filtering.

ListSignals.title: Get job signal list
ListSignals.summary: Queries all signal records of a specified job.

ListTensorboards.title: Query tensorboard list
ListTensorboards.summary: Queries a list of created Tensorboard instances.

SetJobTemplateDefaultVersion.title: SetJobTemplateDefaultVersion
SetJobTemplateDefaultVersion.summary: Sets the default version of a job template.

TagResources.title: Create and attach tags to specified resources
TagResources.summary: Creates and attaches tags to specified resources.

UntagResources.title: Unbind tags from a specified list of resources
UntagResources.summary: Unbinds tags from a specified list of resources.

UpdateJob.title: UpdateJob
UpdateJob.summary: Updates a job's configuration, such as its priority.
